name: InferRSI
description: Research inference optimizations and prepare, run and inspect evidence-based comparisons.

display_description.en: Find cited inference knowledge, prepare controlled comparisons and inspect experiment evidence.
display_description.zh: 检索有来源的推理优化知识，准备受控基线与候选对比，并解读实验进度、证据和验证结论。

default_init_input.en: Use InferRSI to research an inference bottleneck in this project and cite the relevant knowledge.
default_init_input.zh: 使用 InferRSI 分析当前项目的推理瓶颈，检索相关知识并列出依据。

quick_inputs.en: Use InferRSI to research an inference bottleneck in this project and cite the relevant knowledge.
quick_inputs.zh: 使用 InferRSI 分析当前项目的推理瓶颈，检索相关知识并列出依据。

quick_inputs.en: Use InferRSI to prepare a controlled baseline/candidate comparison without starting an experiment.
quick_inputs.zh: 使用 InferRSI 准备受控的基线与候选对比方案，先不启动实验。

quick_inputs.en: Use InferRSI to inspect the experiment directory I provide and explain its verdict and missing evidence.
quick_inputs.zh: 使用 InferRSI 读取我提供的实验目录，解释验证结论和缺失证据。

display_description.en: Read the installed launcher's absolute path without executing it.
display_description.zh: 只读获取已安装启动器的绝对路径，不执行命令。
